business_model.sells: The whole client-getting system for an expert business, built in this order (Matan, 26 Oct 2026): 1 Research: deep research on the client's buyers, competitors and market (who buys, in their own words, and what already wins in the niche). 2 Offer: from the research, an offer with a unique mechanism, so the client is the only choice and not one of many to compare. 3 Organic: a content machine that attracts the right buyers organically. 4 Funnel: a landing page that attracts the buyer, shows the offer and takes the conversions. 5 Paid ads: Meta ads (Facebook, Instagram) that put money only behind what already worked organically, aimed at the same buyer. Later, not in the offer yet: an AI VSL made with HeyGen, tested on StraightScale first. Open, ask before using: the sales team StraightScale provides and trains, and the CRM for every client (25 Oct operator facts, not in Matan's 26 Oct list; decision E2).
business_model.price_notes: unknown: no price for the English offer in any source. The Albanian Client Engine packages (Silver, Gold, Diamond) are a separate offer and never apply here (E4, Matan, plan 28 Oct: no prices in content, captions or the DM bot).
business_model.capacity: unknown: the 19 Oct capacity note (about 10 new client businesses that month) was recorded for the Albanian offer; nothing is stated for the English offer (not covered by E4).
business_model.sales_process: Free entry: a free business analysis, a 45-minute video call including a look at the prospect's competitors' ads, booked by a link a person sends (E3, Matan, plan 28 Oct). What happens after it (proposal, price, contract) is not written for the English offer, and no price is ever said (E4). Content path designed so far: reach reels end on a follow CTA for the next part of the series; EN 02 asks for the keyword WORDS; the DM sends the WORDS Sheet, asks one question (the main bottleneck) and, in the proposed routing, hands a named bottleneck to a person who sends a short voice note and invites them to the free business analysis. Not live: the hub funnel is not created (decision E3).

offer.main_offer: The whole client-getting system, in order: Research, Offer, Organic, Funnel, Paid ads (paid ads only behind what already worked organically). Every content idea must lead to one of these five steps (offer sheet). Free entry: a free business analysis (strategy meeting), including a look at the prospect's competitors' ads.

offer.delivers: The free business analysis: a 45-minute video call that includes a look at the prospect's competitors' ads, booked by a link a person sends (E3, Matan, plan 28 Oct). What the person keeps afterwards is not recorded.

avatars.name: The lumpy-pipeline owner
avatars.role: Founder-led coach, consultant or small agency owner (the offer sheet also names high-ticket service businesses), English-speaking, global, about $20K to $50K USD a month, goal about 5x (offer sheet). Late 30s to mid 40s, works from a home office (EN 03 persona card). Research: consultants and agency owners first, coaches second (09-AVATARS AV-01).
avatars.situation: Her best clients came by referral and she likes them. One channel she runs by hand (LinkedIn, cold email) works, but not predictably: full months, then quiet ones. In the full month she is too busy to look for the next (EN 03 brief and persona cards; 09-AVATARS AV-01).
avatars.keeps_up: The quiet month; the client who leaves ("Half of our MRR just got cut with that.", Q-R-0120); weeks of outreach with no replies; "every year I convince myself it is the end of the world" (Q-R-0127).

mechanism.ump: Patchwork Marketing: growth stitched from separate freelancers, agencies, courses and tools, so nothing compounds and nobody owns the result (offer sheet). mechanism.ums: Organic first, then paid: organic content is the free test lab, and paid ads only go behind posts that already brought the right buyers; research before content, offer before ads (offer sheet). The method stays unnamed (E1, Matan, plan 28 Oct).
mechanism.step_names_open: Decided (E1, Matan, plan 28 Oct): plain step names Research, Offer, Organic, Funnel, Paid ads; the method stays unnamed. Earlier Find, Own, Attract, Convert, Close and the suggested Find, Own, Attract, Convert, Scale are not used.
mechanism.big_idea: Steady months, without adding one more tactic. (EN 03 angle, GATE 3, Matan 27 Oct)
mechanism.contrast_line: Most agencies test the message with the client's ad budget. We put ads only behind posts that already brought the right buyers. (offer sheet, Why it is different)
mechanism.picture: One cloth: the buyers' own words; the offer, the posts, the page and the ads are each cut from it, in order (EN 03 to EN 06).

belief_ladder.statement: My months swing (lumpy, feast or famine), and each fix I added held a month, then came loose.
It isn't my channel or my fault: every fix was patched on alone (Patchwork Marketing).
It can be solved: steady months come from building the pieces in order, each cut from the one before.
The order is research the buyers' words, then the offer, organic posts, a matching page, and paid ads last, only behind posts that worked.
One system built in that order beats one more agency, freelancer, course or tool.
It works for a business like mine (needs proof with evidence; process content until then).
I trust and like the StraightScale people.
The free business analysis is easy, safe and worth doing now.
